name: what-template
description: Shows the current template name in the WordPress admin bar with support for classic, hybrid, and block themes.

scripts.build:zip: rm -rf dist what-template.zip && mkdir -p dist/what-template && cp -R src/. dist/what-template/ && find dist -name '.DS_Store' -delete && cd dist && zip -rq ../what-template.zip what-template
scripts.test:setup: yes | WP_TESTS_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wordpress-tests-lib WP_CORE_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wordpress bin/install-wp-tests.sh wordpress_test root '' localhost latest

author: ironprogrammer
